description:
The Firmstrong Rebel Fat Tire 7-Speed takes the effortless cool of a step-through cruiser and pairs it with massive 26-inch x 4-inch tires to create a bike that is as fearless as it is comfortable. While a classic cruiser shines on the pavement, the Rebel Fat Tire is designed for the rider who wants the freedom to explore the shoreline, trek through loose dirt, or navigate gravel paths with total confidence. Those oversized 4-inch tires act like a cushion, allowing you to float over soft sand and uneven terrain that would stop a standard bike in its tracks. With its signature low-entry frame, the Rebel makes it easier than ever to hop on and go, providing a spacious and stable ride for women from 5 feet 3 inches to 6 feet 3 inches tall.

To make sure you have the power to match the Rebel's rugged build, we’ve equipped it with a Shimano 7-speed gear system. We know that moving a larger, high-capacity bike requires a bit of extra help, and these seven speeds ensure that pedaling feels smooth and light, whether you’re cruising against a coastal headwind or tackling a neighborhood incline. You get all the "go-anywhere" capability of an all-terrain bike without sacrificing the relaxed, upright riding position that Firmstrong is famous for—keeping your weight off your wrists and your eyes on the scenery.

Safety and control are paramount when handling the extra momentum of a fat tire build, which is why the Rebel features TekTro mechanic disc brakes. Unlike traditional rim brakes that can lose grip in wet or sandy environments, disc brakes offer crisp, reliable stopping power in any weather. This is especially important for a reinforced model designed to support up to 350 pounds. Durable, stylish, and built to handle the elements, the Rebel Fat Tire 7-Speed is the ultimate upgrade for the rider who wants a graceful step-through look but refuses to be limited by where the pavement ends.

15.5-Inch Reinforced Steel Frame with a high-tensile Thick-Tube design for maximum strength and durability

26-Inch x 4.0-Inch Fat Tires provide incredible traction and a stable ride on sand, gravel, and dirt where standard tires sink

7-Speed Shimano Gearing offers a wide range of speeds to make pedaling the larger wheels easy on hills or long-distance rides

Front and Rear Tektro Disc Brakes deliver powerful, consistent stopping control even in wet or sandy conditions

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for added comfort on bumpy trails and longer cruises

Heavy-Duty Alloy Rims with 14G Stainless Steel spokes to handle tough terrain and

28.5-Inch Wide Cruiser Handlebars with synthetic leather grips for a relaxed, upright riding position

Bicycle Weighs approximately 55 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’3” – 6’3” Tall and is built to support riders up to 400 lbs

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25 mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
